items.summary: Disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide security clearance; blocked for security-sensitive public exposure; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Concrete evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication boundaries, secrets handling, container isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, data exposure, monitoring, incident response, and security.txt/disclosure readiness remain unverified. TLS evidence shows no certificates expiring within 30 days only and does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance is a technical baseline only: 37 pass, 16 fail, and 6 unknown. Retained worker and reviewer failures are containment signals, not evidence of compromise. Exact decision: keep private launch gates unchanged, continue bounded read-only security evidence capture, and permit only reversible growth adding no credentials, permissions, dependencies, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Risk severity is high for public exposure and security-sensitive release, medium for bounded growth.

Continue the existing security evidence work only. Do not retrieve credentials, access private containers, exploit targets, change permissions, modify production, deploy, add dependencies, request duplicate telemetry, or conduct external outreach. Record dated evidence, owners, affected scope, explicit unknowns, severity, and release implications for authentication, secrets, isolation, release controls, dependencies, data exposure, monitoring, incidents, TLS, and disclosure readiness.
